mapper.select: select r.* from role r inner join user_role ur on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by r.role_id

SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN role r ON rp.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN user_role ur ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 AND r.status = 1
